sources.summary: TorchTPU is an open-source project developed by Google in collaboration with Meta that provides a native PyTorch backend for Google TPUs. It enables PyTorch workloads to execute on TPU hardware with minimal code modifications, supporting eager and compiled execution, distributed computing, and hardware-specific optimizations. By Sergio De Simone

sources.title: Uber Builds MCP Gateway to Govern Access to 800+ Servers and 5,000+ AI Agent Tools
sources.summary: Uber has built an MCP Gateway to standardize how AI agents discover and invoke internal services across more than 800 MCP servers and 5,000 tools. The gateway separates tool registration from runtime execution and includes automated API discovery, access controls, sensitive data redaction, incremental tool discovery through Omni MCP, and response filtering. By Leela Kumili

events.title: Article: Systemic Approach to Memory, Knowledge, and Context in Agentic AI Architectures

sources.name: InfoQ
sources.title: Article: Systemic Approach to Memory, Knowledge, and Context in Agentic AI Architectures
sources.summary: The article argues that reliable agentic AI architecture depends on a context engine that selects, injects, compresses, and expires information before it reaches the model. It separates context, memory, and knowledge, and recommends tiered memory, curated knowledge, and token budgeting. It also covers common anti-patterns, such as context stuffing and stale data loops, with mitigations. By Adi Polak
